sph_interpretive_translation: That which is spoken by the appointed one, though fallen from favor, must still be executed as dharma.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority inheres in designation, not personal virtue
Causation flows from role, not individual intent
Capacity-based responsibility arises from appointment, not approval
Restoration logic demands continuity of function despite personal lapse
Consciousness alignment occurs through submission to designated order
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent is designated THEN action validity derives from role, not actor state
IF utterance originates from authorized position THEN enforceability persists regardless of speaker's fallibility
IF capacity is formally assigned THEN execution priority overrides personal disqualification
IF dharma function is disrupted THEN restoration occurs via structural continuity, not punitive replacement
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, when a designated authority has spoken lawfully from their station—even if later shown to have erred personally—their declaration remains operative until structurally superseded. Responsibility lies in maintaining systemic integrity over personality-based invalidation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that truth inheres in the structural utterance, not the speaker's condition. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms sequential dependence upon designated voice. Proportional responsibility aligns with preserving functional hierarchy. Non-punitive reality affirms that error does not erase ontological validity of positional speech.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Ensure all directives issued under valid appointment are fulfilled regardless of subsequent personal status
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Reaffirm structural accountability through successor alignment, not nullification
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Reintegrate fallen authority figures through corrective realignment, not removal
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Stabilize institutional function before addressing individual misalignment
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this verse is established as law: authority speaks through office, not person; dharma executes through structure, not sentiment; reality restores through continuity, not punishment; consciousness adjudicates beyond fallible appearance.
